scientific_ai__native_md_gateway__submis.description: Ordered native AMBER workflows in a complete gzip-tar bundle. MDIN, topology, coordinates, restraints, reference files and alchemical context remain explicit. Native PMEMD CUDA SPFP/DPFP and CPU are distinct choices. Completed stages checkpoint the full stopped workspace; an interrupted active stage retries from the preceding committed stage, not an arbitrary partial restart. This Serverless integration executes exactly one isolated job per operation. Use separate submissions for independent replicas. Native checkpoints are not GPU snapshots.

input.description: Native MDIN or native tool script, relative to the step directory. No shell command or arbitrary executable interface is added.

topology.description: PMEMD topology; optional default topology for cpptraj or ParmEd.

coordinates.description: PMEMD initial coordinates/restart; optional ParmEd coordinates.

reference.description: PMEMD restraint reference, passed with -ref. All auxiliary native dependencies must also be bundled.

task.description: PMEMD completion assertion only; never rewrites imin or the native scientific settings.

expected_nsteps.description: Required for dynamics: exact requested native nstlim, checked against native input echo and final NSTEP. A timlim early exit is incomplete.

output_prefix.description: Native output stem, defaulting to step ID: PMEMD uses .mdout/.rst7/.nc/.mdvel/.mden/.mdinfo; MMPBSA uses .dat/.csv plus a stage-specific intermediate prefix.

output.description: Antechamber MOL2 or parmchk2 FRCMOD output filename.

input_format.description: Explicit molecular input format; parmchk2 currently accepts MOL2 only.

atom_types.description: Explicit native small-molecule parameter set; default GAFF2.

net_charge.description: Antechamber requested total molecular charge in electron units.

charge_equivalence.description: Native-eq option:0none,1atomic paths,2paths and stereochemistry. Default1; changing it is a scientific input change.

charge_tolerance_e.description: Explicit final MOL2 charge-sum assertion; default0.001e. Residual is always reported, never silently corrected.

trajectories.description: MMPBSA explicit trajectory filenames in order, not shell globs.

expected_frames.description: MMPBSA exact analyzed-frame assertion for every component energy table; never rewrites native frame selection.

use_mdins.description: MMPBSA-only native-use-mdins: caller supplies complete prefix.intermediate_gb.mdin/pb.mdin context. No native MDIN is rewritten by the worker.

expected_outputs.description: Additional nonempty native outputs required for completion. Required nonempty for preparation/analysis tools; their scientific interpretation remains workflow-specific.

threads.description: CPU/tool threading limit; one process and at most one GPU. No multi-GPU/MPI qualification is implied.

max_wall_seconds.description: Per-job execution budget in seconds, including checkpoint I/O; default and maximum fourteen days. Explicit smaller budgets are preserved.

max_output_bytes.description: Optional explicit cap on retained workspace bytes, including inputs and outputs. Omit to use available authorized storage without an additional workflow cap. Execution scratch and customer bucket capacity still apply; native files and output cadence are preserved.

scientific_ai__native_md_gateway__submis.description: NVIDIA NAMD 3.0.2 single-GPU native workflows. One immutable gzip-tar bundle holds config/Tcl, PSF/PDB or compatible topology, parameters, and restart/bias files. Native Tcl is executable user code inside an isolated worker, not a sandboxed expression language. GBIS and spinAngle Colvars are unavailable in this pinned build. No multi-node or persistent GPU snapshot claim. This Serverless integration executes exactly one isolated job per operation. Use separate submissions for independent replicas. Native checkpoints are not GPU snapshots.

max_wall_seconds.description: Per-job execution budget in seconds, including checkpoint I/O; default and maximum fourteen days. Explicit smaller budgets are preserved.

max_output_bytes.description: Optional explicit cap on retained workspace bytes, including inputs and outputs. Omit to use available authorized storage without an additional workflow cap. Execution scratch and customer bucket capacity still apply; native files and output cadence are preserved.

mode.description: dynamics: configuration-only Tcl plus finite wrapper-managed run segments; native: complete NAMD Tcl program, completion-boundary recovery only; prepare: bundled psfgen Tcl script, completion-boundary recovery only.

segment_steps.description: Finite native run length between closed-output checkpoints. Must align with stepsPerCycle and nonbonded/PME intervals. Each segment creates independent part files; cadence stays in the native config.

output_prefix.description: Managed dynamics output basename; each segment gets .partNNNNNN, and final .coor/.vel/.xsc aliases are produced. Omit outputName/DCDfile/restartName from configuration-only scripts.

restart.description: External native continuation. Coordinates, velocities, cell and enabled Colvars bias state must come from the same checkpoint; XSC timestep must equal first_step. Config uses fs2_restart to omit fresh velocity/cell initialization.

initialize_colvars.description: Explicitly introduce a new bias when starting this dynamics stage from an unbiased native checkpoint. Subsequent segments must restore the resulting bias state.

scientific_ai__native_md_gateway__submis.description: Ordered native LAMMPS scripts in a complete gzip-tar bundle: include/data/potential files and explicit continuation context. Scientific parameters and units remain in the scripts. Independent jobs have isolated files and random seeds chosen by the customer. This Serverless integration executes exactly one isolated job per operation. Use separate submissions for independent replicas. Native checkpoints are not GPU snapshots.

input.description: Native LAMMPS input script relative to directory. Includes, native variables, loops, minimization, dynamics and analysis retain native semantics.

backend.description: Optional per-stage accelerator profile; CPU fallback must be explicit.

variables.description: Native index variables supplied as separate -var name value argv entries. Names beginning fs2_ are reserved.

continuation.description: Opt-in native segmentation. Scripts must write a closed restart and integer timestep after each run, use fs2_segment_seconds timer timeout, and recreate complete restart context. Worker independently reads the restart timestep. Outputs must preserve segment history.

backend.description: One MPI rank and at most one GPU. KOKKOS uses half neighbor lists and Newton on by default for compatible modern-GPU execution; native package/newton commands override these defaults. Acceleration applies only to installed accelerated styles; retain engine logs to inspect dispatch. The separate GPU package is not built into this pinned NVIDIA image.

threads.description: OpenMP threads for native CPU styles. The pinned KOKKOS CUDA build has a Serial host backend and always uses one KOKKOS host thread.

segment_seconds.description: Offered native timer duration for scripts opting into continuation. Native timestep boundaries can delay exit. Does not rewrite arbitrary scripts.

max_wall_seconds.description: Per-job execution budget in seconds, including checkpoint I/O; default and maximum fourteen days. Explicit smaller budgets are preserved.

mode.description: Use transfer for full-sequence appearance augmentation of recorded trajectories: edge/blur controls guide every source frame. video-to-video conditions only selected prefix/suffix latent frames and generates the remaining motion; it does not preserve the recorded trajectory. Neither mode establishes physical action alignment or policy-training validity.

prompt_template.description: Generation prompt with optional {task}, {episode_index}, {camera}, {variation}, {instruction} placeholders. Include {variation} or {instruction} to insert the dimensions' instructions and strengths; without either placeholder those dimension descriptions are not inserted into the prompt.

strength.description: Descriptive strength inserted into the generation prompt, not a numeric denoising parameter or spatial-control weight.

keep.description: Prefix/suffix selection for video-to-video only. Required for the common request shape but not used to truncate transfer's full-sequence controls.
